headline: A map of what your code builds and how the parts connect
body: Open your ontology folder: the map is drawn from the few lines at the top of each file, which coding agents like <keep>Claude Code</keep> read and write too.
bodyNoFolderAccess: The map is drawn from the few lines at the top of each markdown file, which coding agents like <keep>Claude Code</keep> read and write too.
sampleRelationExample: For example, a relation like “Orders → Fulfillment”.
buildFromCodeHint: Pick a code folder and Atlas creates an atlas folder inside it; your coding agent reads the code and proposes a draft. It shows you the path before creating, and asks before every write.
glossaryToggle: What domains, capabilities and elements mean
plainModeHint: Need an easier view? Turn on "General" in the gear at the bottom left
errorFallback: Could not open the folder. Try again.
unsupportedNotice: This browser can't open local folders. Open it in the desktop app or Chrome/Edge to see your folder as a map.
cliBridgeLabel: Reads the folder you run it in and drafts a map
cliBridgeCopyAriaLabel: Copy the start command to paste in your terminal

readout.synthetic: Performance test · {count, plural, one {# synthetic concept} other {# synthetic concepts}}

sampleSourceStorefrontTip: Products, orders, members, delivery: learn to read the map with names everyone knows
sampleSourceDogfoodTip: The map of the code that built this app: people and agents actually built it, and the Git history shows it
cliBridgeSourceOnly: This command runs inside an ontology-atlas source checkout. You do not need it if you only use the app.
errorRootRejected: This folder cannot become a map. Pick a folder that holds documents, not a system folder or your whole home folder.
errorPathMissing: That folder is gone. It looks like it was moved or deleted. Pick another one.
errorGrantNeeded: After this update, choose your ontology folder once to confirm access. Your documents are still there.
buildFromCodeWillCreate: Create the ontology folder inside this code folder?
buildFromCodeReuse: Continue in this code folder's ontology folder?
buildFromCodeFailed: The folder could not be created. Check that you can write to this code folder.
errorPermissionDenied: macOS is protecting the folder “{folder}”. Allow Ontology Atlas in System Settings under Privacy & Security, then Files and Folders, and open it again.
buildFromCodeSteppedUp: That folder is an ontology folder, so Atlas used the code folder that contains it.
buildFromCodeSafety: Your code is left alone; only this folder is new.
buildFromCodeSafetyReuse: Nothing new is created; the existing folder is used as it is.
